g.text: Generation speedup | GAGP GPU-er-o vs. ASGP 1T
Speedup = ASGP generation time median / GAGP generation time median | 3 seeds per mode | Higher is faster
One bar per generation | Full population = 1024, all 1024 cases | Dashed line: ASGP parity (1x)
Above 1x: GAGP is faster. Below 1x: ASGP is faster. Per-generation ratios exclude one-time initialization and final-only evaluation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: These are evolving-population system comparisons, not fixed-program speedups or complete-search wall-time ratios. Panel scales differ.
